scientific_integrity: Mathematical classification and Poisson limit are proved for explicitly defined finite incidence posets and uniform labelled degree-at-most-two loopless multigraphs. Verification code exhaustively tests finite instances; neither computation nor review is independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Does not extend to arbitrary posets, alternate implication operators, or other random graph models. The point/block/top realization and edge-occurrence conventions are essential. General degree-two graph enumeration and Poisson-component methods are classical and not independently novel; equivalent earlier logical formulations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Twin-block rigidity of unsharp implication and its Poisson sharpness law
